cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Hi, this is Michelin Meyer. I'm renting your house on Archwood Avenue.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I'm due to move in next week.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh, yes. Hello, Ms. Meyer. What can I do for you?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: When I viewed the house, I told you I'll most probably need to rent some furniture, at

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: least until I know whether my temporary work contract is going to be made permanent.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, of course. I remember.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And I said I could give you some information about furniture rental companies in the city.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well, the biggest company is called Peak Rentals.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I've recommended them to other people and have always heard positive reports about them.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Sure. I actually have one of their brochures here.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It says the monthly price per room starts at $105 and goes up to $239.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That depends on which rooms you need furniture for, of course.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Sure. It's just to get a general idea of how much it's going to cost.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And you said you had some positive feedback about this company?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: People have mentioned that the furniture from Peak Rentals is more modern than any of the

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: other companies.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And also, once you place an order, the furniture will be delivered to you in just one or

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: two days.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh, and the brochure says that there's a special offer at the moment.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: If you rent living room furniture, I believe that's a set of chairs and a TV table,

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: you'll also get a lamp at no extra cost.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Okay, but you know, that price range you gave is more than I was hoping to pay.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I'd say they are a mid-price company.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: But if you chose them you need to be aware that they charge an extra $12 every month in

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: case of damage.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh, I see. I'd have to do the math carefully then.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Right. But one helpful thing is that they also do cleaning for customers.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: There's another company called Larch Furniture.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's quite new, and it has the lowest prices in town.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That's for both furniture and also electronic equipment.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well, that would be good.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I'm not bringing much with me, and I won't have much time to go shopping after I start my

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: job.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: There are two things you need to know about Larch Furniture.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: First of all you have to take out insurance on the furniture and you need to organize

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: that yourself.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Also you can take out a contract for less than six months but I figure that might not be

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: a problem for you. You're renting the house for 12 months after all, aren't you?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Sorry to interrupt. I just thought of another furniture rental company.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's called Space Rentals, and it's located very near to the house.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I don't have any information about their charges, so it's best to use their app to find

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: out what it would cost you to use them.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: One good thing about that company is that if you don't like the furniture once it's

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: delivered, you can request exchanges, as long as you do that within a week of receiving

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: it.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That sounds really great. Okay, well, thanks very much. That's so helpful.
